title: Off Broadway: Rooftop Hot Tub and City Views | NEW
description:
Soak in a private rooftop hot tub with downtown skyline views, then ride 12 minutes to Broadway. Off Broadway is a theater-inspired 3BR/3BA home for groups up to 10: hand-painted murals, a lighted glam vanity, a stocked kitchen with a coffee bar, and a 2-car garage so you never hunt for parking. Two rooftop decks, Putterball, fast Wi-Fi and keyless self check-in. Your Nashville encore starts here.

The space
THE ROOFTOP
Two decks with skyline views: a lounge with the private hot tub, outdoor seating and Putterball, plus an outdoor dining table. Reached by a spiral staircase.

THE BEDROOMS (each with its own bathroom)
- The Garden Suite (king): a floor-to-ceiling hand-painted floral mural, plus an ensuite with a walk-in tiled shower and double vanity.
- The Sunset Room (2 queens): warm savanna tones, a slatted accent wall, and a lighted makeup vanity. Ensuite tub and shower.
- The Bunk Room (queen-over-queen bunk): deep navy, cozy, and a favorite for groups. Ensuite tub and shower.

LIVING AND KITCHEN
An open living room with a leather Chesterfield sofa, a music mural and a smart TV. The kitchen has a quartz island with seating, full-size appliances and a Keurig coffee bar.

THE PRACTICAL STUFF
2-car garage, washer and dryer, a desk for working, and fast Wi-Fi throughout.

Guest access
The whole home is yours: all three bedrooms, three bathrooms, the kitchen and living room, the laundry, the rooftop decks with the private hot tub, and the attached two-car garage. Entry is keyless through the garage or the front door. Extra cars can use the shared lot; our neighbors share it and the walkways too, so please keep voices low outside.

Other things to note
- Metro Nashville STR Permit #2026070545
- Broadway is a 12-minute drive or rideshare. The home isn't within walking distance of downtown.
- The home has three levels plus the rooftop, and the rooftop is reached by an outdoor spiral staircase.
- Rooftop murals are still in progress, so you may see partially painted walls on the rooftop during your stay. Everything else is finished and ready for you.
- Maximum 10 guests, no parties or events, and quiet hours are 11 PM-7 AM, including on the rooftop.
